title.narrative: Scaling Up Renewable Energy Financing Facility

description.narrative: Over the past five years, the Jordanian renewable energy (RE) sector has experienced a remarkable growth, increasing the RE installed capacity from about 20 MW to over 1,000 MW (with an estimated 800 MW under construction). This growth, however, comes with significant challenges, as Jordan needs to take measures to improve the demand-supply balance and the capacity of the grid to absorb further intermittent RE generation, while ensuring the grid’s stability. The project was intended to support the enhancement of the legal and regulatory framework in terms of grid infrastructure to support increases in RE generation capacity and provide investment support for the construction of a pumped hydroelectric energy storage (PHES) with 450MW installed capacity by blending public and private funding in the volume of ca EUR 550 m.
